theme: 3 terms on privacy permissions: the system alert that asks the user, the sentence that explains why, and the current answer you check before asking

terms.definition: The system alert that asks the user to let your app use something private, like the camera.
terms.example: Don't show the Permission Prompt on launch, ask when the user taps Scan.

terms.definition: The sentence in your app's Info plist that tells the user why you need a permission.
terms.example: Write a clear Usage Description, a vague one can get the app rejected.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let key = "NSCameraUsageDescription"
let text = Bundle.main
    .object(forInfoDictionaryKey: key)
print(text ?? "missing")

terms.definition: The current answer for a permission: not asked yet, allowed, denied or restricted.
terms.example: Check the Authorization Status first, the prompt only appears once.

quizzes.question: What tells you if the user has already allowed or denied a permission?
What is the sentence that explains why your app needs a permission?
What do you call the system alert that asks the user to allow camera access?

video.title: Permission Prompt, Usage Description & Authorization Status | Day 90
video.description:
Learn to explain how iOS apps ask for private data like the camera: Permission Prompt, Usage Description & Authorization Status, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Permission Prompt - The system alert that asks the user to let your app use something private, like the camera.
Usage Description - The sentence in your app's Info plist that tells the user why you need a permission.
Authorization Status - The current answer for a permission: not asked yet, allowed, denied or restricted.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 90 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.description:
Explain Permission Prompt, Usage Description & Authorization Status in UIKit by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
권한 요청 알림, 사용 목적 설명, 권한 상태 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Permission Prompt - The system alert that asks the user to let your app use something private, like the camera.
한국어: 권한 요청 알림: 카메라처럼 민감한 기능을 앱이 써도 되는지 사용자에게 묻는 시스템 알림

Usage Description - The sentence in your app's Info plist that tells the user why you need a permission.
한국어: 사용 목적 설명: 앱이 왜 그 권한이 필요한지 사용자에게 알려주는 Info plist 속 문장

Authorization Status - The current answer for a permission: not asked yet, allowed, denied or restricted.
한국어: 권한 상태: 권한에 대한 현재 답으로, 아직 묻지 않음, 허용, 거부, 제한 중 하나

landscape.hook: Tap Scan and the app crashes. Can you explain why in English?

dialogue.title: Why does Scan crash?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the app crashes the moment I tap Scan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does the Info plist have a Usage Description for the camera?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Without a Usage Description, iOS kills the app instead of asking.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, added. Now the Permission Prompt shows our text.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Now tap Don't Allow and try again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nothing happens. No Permission Prompt this time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, iOS asks only once. After that, check the Authorization Status first.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Show a short message with a link to Settings. Only the user can change it there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Usage Description first, then check the Authorization Status before every scan.
Ask at the right moment, the Permission Prompt only shows once.
